hook.name: NakamotoHook
hook.description: A bonding curve hook that mints NakamotoToken on ETH buys and burns it on sells, fully replacing standard AMM swap math via BeforeSwapDelta. Buys are capped at 5 ETH and disabled after the curve reaches 3,000 ETH implied; sells incur a 5% exit fee (3% retained in treasury, 2% to a fee receiver) and require a 1-block cooldown after the buyer's last buy.
